entities.name: Pavios
entities.description: A young man from Meletis, star-crossed lover of Thanasis, who wishes to study magic.

entities.name: Thanasis
entities.description: A blacksmith's son from Akros who loves Pavios.

entities.name: Adrasteia
entities.description: A Fate who cut herself severing the tangle of the lovers' threads.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: Dark god of the dead who offers the lovers eternity together in his realm.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City of Pavios's birth with a school of magic.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City of Thanasis with an army.

entities.name: Fleecemane Lion
entities.description: A lion that kills a rabbit and mauls the cloak and pack.

events.summary: Pavios moves to Akros, meets Thanasis, and they fall in love.
events.quote: Pavios met his neighbor, the blacksmith's son Thanasis, and they fell in love.

events.summary: Thanasis gives Pavios his cloak and Pavios gives a short sword; Thanasis speaks of his mother's death and Pavios kisses him.
events.quote: Pavios comforted him with a kiss.

events.summary: Their fathers forbid the meetings; Pavios sneaks a note and they agree to meet at the cliff.
events.quote: Their fathers then forbid them from seeing each other

events.summary: Pavios, waiting at the cliff, sees a Fleecemane Lion kill a rabbit; it sees him and he flees into a gorge cave.
events.quote: Then the lion raised its head and saw him.

events.summary: Pavios returns to find Thanasis dead against the emonberry tree, pierced by the sword he gave him.
events.quote: And then he saw Thanasis lying against the emonberry tree, his chest pierced by the sword Pavios had given him.

events.summary: Pavios prays to Erebos, who promises they can be together in his realm; Pavios falls on his sword.
events.quote: And so, Pavios threw himself on his sword, and for a moment, he laughed.

relations.quote: Pavios from Meletis and Thanasis from Akros were star-crossed lovers from Theros
